units.source_text: 他把眼泪揩干，前往访问老尼姑弁君。

en.t: He wiped away his tears and went to visit the old nun Ben no Kimi.

units.source_text: 弁君一见薰大将，悲从中来，几乎哭泣。

en.t: As soon as Ben no Kimi saw Captain Kaoru, grief rose within her and she nearly wept.

units.source_text: 薰大将就在门边坐下，把帘子的一端揭起，和她谈话。

en.t: Captain Kaoru sat down by the doorway, lifted one edge of the curtain, and spoke with her.

units.source_text: 弁君隐身在帷屏背后对答。

en.t: Ben no Kimi kept herself hidden behind the curtains and screens as she answered him.

units.source_text: 谈话中薰大将顺便说到浮舟：“听说那位小姐前几天来到匂亲王家里。

en.t: In the course of their talk, Captain Kaoru happened to mention Ukifune: "I hear that young lady came to Prince Niou's house a few days ago.

units.source_text: 我觉得不好意思，不曾向她开口。

en.t: I felt too embarrassed and have not spoken to her about it.

units.source_text: 还是请你传达吧。”

en.t: Please convey it to her for me instead."

units.source_text: 弁君答道：“前天她母亲来过信了。

en.t: Ben no Kimi replied, "The day before yesterday, a letter came from her mother.

units.source_text: 她们为了避凶，正在东奔西走。

en.t: They are moving from place to place to avoid ill fortune.

units.source_text: 信中说道：‘目前隐避在一简陋之小屋中，甚是可怜。

en.t: The letter said, 'For now we are hiding in a humble little cottage, in a most pitiable state.

units.source_text: 如果宇治离京稍近，颇思托庇贵处，以求安心。

en.t: If Uji were a little closer to the capital, we would very much wish to take shelter with you and find some peace.

units.source_text: 然而山路崎岖，往来诚非易事。’”

en.t: But the mountain road is rough, and traveling back and forth is truly no easy matter.'"

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“大家都怕走这山路，只有我一向不惮烦劳，常常跋涉而来。

en.t: Captain Kaoru said, "Everyone fears traveling this mountain road, yet I alone have never shrunk from the trouble and have often made the hard journey here.

units.source_text: 这是何等深厚的宿缘，想起了感慨无量！”

en.t: What a deep bond from former lives this must be; when I think of it, my feelings are beyond measure!"

units.source_text: 说到这里，照例流下泪来。

en.t: At this point, as usual, tears began to fall from his eyes.

units.source_text: 又说：“那么，就请你写一封信，送到这无人注目的小屋中去吧。

en.t: He went on, "Then please write a letter and send it to that unnoticed little cottage.

units.source_text: 且慢，还是请你亲自去走一遭吧。”

en.t: No, wait; please go there yourself after all."

units.source_text: 弁君答道：“要传达尊意，事甚容易。

en.t: Ben no Kimi answered, "It would be very easy to convey your wishes.

units.source_text: 只是现在再要我到京都去，实在为难。

en.t: But to ask me to go to Kyoto again now is truly difficult.

units.source_text: 我连二条院也不曾去过呢。”

en.t: I have not even been to Nijo-in."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“你也何必如此！

en.t: Captain Kaoru said, "There is no need for you to be so extreme.

units.source_text: 叫人送信，万一被人闻知，须不好看。

en.t: If I send someone with a letter and people happen to find out, it would look improper.

units.source_text: 即使是爱宕山中的高僧，也常因时制宜，下山进京去呢。

en.t: Even eminent monks on Mount Atago often adapt to circumstances and come down the mountain into the capital.

units.source_text: 打破自己清戒，成就他人夙愿，正是莫大功德。”

en.t: To break one's own pure discipline in order to fulfill another person's long-cherished wish is precisely a great act of merit."

units.source_text: 弁君说：“可惜，‘我身不积济人德’呀！

en.t: Ben no Kimi said, "Unfortunately, 'this body of mine has not accumulated the virtue to save others.'

units.source_text: 进京去干这种事，被人听到了闹笑话呢。”

en.t: If I went up to the capital to do such a thing and people heard about it, I would be laughed at."

units.source_text: 她不愿去。

en.t: She was unwilling to go.

units.source_text: 薰大将异常坚决地强请：“还是得你去一趟，此次正是绝好机会。

en.t: Captain Kaoru pressed her with unusual firmness: "You really must go this once; this is exactly the perfect opportunity.

units.source_text: 后天我派车子来接你吧。

en.t: The day after tomorrow I will send a carriage to fetch you.

units.source_text: 你先把她寓居之所调查清楚。

en.t: First, find out clearly where she is staying.

units.source_text: 我决不胡行乱为，使你为难。”

en.t: I will certainly not behave recklessly and put you in difficulty."

units.source_text: 说着笑了起来。

en.t: As he said this, he began to laugh.

units.source_text: 弁君不知道他有何意图，甚是担心。

en.t: Ben no Kimi did not know what he intended and was very worried.

units.source_text: 但念此人素无荒唐浅薄之行，一定顾惜外间声望，也决不会连累到她，便答道：“既然如此，只得遵命。

en.t: But thinking that he had never been given to absurd or frivolous conduct, that he would surely care about his public reputation, and that he would never involve her in trouble, she replied, "In that case, I can only obey.

units.source_text: 她的寓所离尊处甚近。

en.t: Her lodging is very close to your residence.

units.source_text: 但请您先去一信。

en.t: But please send her a letter first.

units.source_text: 不然，人家以为我自作聪明，多管闲事，当了尼姑还要做月下老人。

en.t: Otherwise, people will think I am showing off my cleverness and meddling in others' affairs, still trying to play matchmaker even after becoming a nun.

units.source_text: 这便太不成样了。”

en.t: That would be far too unseemly."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“写信很容易，只是恐怕惹起世人议论，以为‘右大将爱上了常陆守的女儿’。

en.t: Captain Kaoru said, "Writing a letter would be easy, but I fear it would stir up gossip, with people saying, 'The Right Captain has fallen in love with the governor of Hitachi's daughter.'

units.source_text: 况且那常陆守是个粗暴的人。”

en.t: Besides, that governor of Hitachi is a rough man."

units.source_text: 弁君笑起来，觉得此人很可怜。

en.t: Ben no Kimi laughed and felt very sorry for him.

units.source_text: 天色渐暗，薰大将告辞出门。

en.t: As the sky gradually darkened, Captain Kaoru took his leave and went out.

units.source_text: 他采了些花草，折了几枝红叶，将以奉赠二公主。

en.t: He picked some flowers and grasses and broke off several branches of red leaves, intending to present them to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 他对二公主并不疏远，只因表示对皇女的敬意，故不十分亲昵。

en.t: He was not distant toward the Second Princess; he was simply not very intimate with her out of respect for her as an imperial daughter.

units.source_text: 皇上对他，像臣民的父亲一般亲爱。

en.t: The Emperor loved him warmly, like a father to his subjects.

units.source_text: 对他母亲尼僧三公主也照顾周至。

en.t: He also took thorough care of Kaoru's mother, the nun Third Princess.

units.source_text: 因此薰大将也奉二公主为高贵无极的正夫人，对她非常重视。

en.t: For this reason, Captain Kaoru revered the Second Princess as his supremely noble principal wife and valued her very highly.

units.source_text: 他深蒙圣眷，又荣任驸马，而私下移爱他人，自心亦觉歉愧。

en.t: He had received deep imperial favor and held the honored position of imperial son-in-law, yet in privately turning his love toward another, he felt ashamed in his own heart as well.
